name: Classic
description: Four short arms, tight gap. The default most pros start from.

name: Dot
description: A single point with an outline. Minimal, zero clutter.

name: T-cross
description: Classic without the top arm — keeps the view above the target clear.

name: Circle dot
description: A thin ring around a center dot. Reads well over busy backdrops.

name: Chevron
description: A ^ just under center — leaves the target itself unobstructed.

name: X-cross
description: Diagonal arms. Popular for spray control — the center stays open.

name: Brackets
description: Corner brackets framing the target with a center dot.

name: Inner + outer
description: Valorant-style: a tight inner cross with dimmer outer lines.

name: Sniper
description: Long hairline arms with a pinpoint dot. For scoped play.

name: Shotgun
description: A wide ring approximating spread, plus a dot.

name: Diamond
description: Thin diagonals around a pinpoint dot — a diamond-shaped reticle.

name: Micro
description: The smallest usable cross: 1px arms, 1px gap.
